title: Chapter 205 Ao Qing Is Promoted
content:
Chapter 205 Ao Qing Is Promoted

However, if you think about it carefully, it is not impossible.

After all, Lu Daosheng himself had known that Lu Xue had always wanted to go out and try it out.

But because I was worried, I never gave Lu Xue a chance.

Now, it is just right for Lu Xue to see the cruelty of the outside world.

And I feel relieved to follow in secret.

Thinking of this, Lu Daosheng nodded unconsciously.

Outside the city lord's mansion.

After Yan Lingyun left, she began to retreat and stabilize her cultivation.

Although I rely on the first life of the backup plan to stay in the fairy world and went straight to the peak of the Immortal Emperor Realm without any obstacles, this is still a shortcut. I can't see it now, but if I don't do anything, I will definitely be in the future Some disadvantages arise in the process of cultivation.

Therefore, Yan Lingyun has no extra time now.

Otherwise, it wouldn't be Lu Daosheng's turn to protect Lu Xue in secret.

At this time, a restaurant in the inner city of Huangcheng.

"Miss Lu Xue, why not, let it go."

An elegant room.

Xiao Chen was silent for a long time, but finally hesitated.

On the side, Xiao Xuanmu nodded in cater to the point.

In the family crisis, they really don’t want to put their hope on a woman who only has the Immortal King realm.

Even if the other party has an extraordinary identity.

But when he heard Xiao Chen's words, Lu Xue shook her head calmly.

"Don't worry, two old gentlemen. Although I am not as capable as my father and as capable as my mother, I have been perfectly inherited in terms of IQ."

"Besides, I haven't tried it, how do you know I can't do it?"

Looking at Lu Xue's confident smile, Xiao Chen and the others looked at each other, and their words in their hearts eventually turned into a heavy sigh.

Forget it.

Let this little girl give it a try, it won't be worse anyway.

And maybe this little girl is not good enough, she will call the old one over to solve the problem.

Then, isn’t the purpose still accomplished?

At this time, Xiao Chen and the others turned around suddenly, and a faint smile appeared on their faces.

"Okay, Miss Lu, I'll ask you for this matter."

Hearing this, Lu Xue patted her chest and said, "Pack to me."

"Then, Miss Lu, when will we set out?"

"Emm, let's go in three days, and you can wait for me in front of the gate of Huangcheng City in three days."

"One word is certain."

Immediately, the three of them left the restaurant and left.

The deserted city has also gradually started to get on track. Although it has developed a little slowly, fortunately, the deserted city is well-known and there is no threat.

After Lu Xue returned to the city lord's mansion, she immediately ran to find Lu Daosheng and asked for a bunch of things, which made Lu Daosheng laugh and cry.

"Xiaoxue, why do you want so many things? Didn't you say you have to rely on yourself?"

Hearing this, Lu Xue waved her hand and said, "Dad, don't let it be so pedantic, okay? I mean I want to go out and make a fortune, but I don't mean I'm going to die. I can't use some things, but I can't leave them out."

This made sense, and Lu Daosheng was stunned for a long time.

"this,,"

"Oh Dad, stop this, hurry up, hand over everything!"

In the end, Lu Daosheng gave Lu Xue many treasures, even though Lu Xue originally had a lot of them.

"By the way Xiaoxue, what happened to Ao Qing?"

After plundering the things, Lu Xue was about to leave, when Lu Daosheng suddenly thought of Ao Qing and asked.

"Ao, Xiaoqing, she has eaten too much again and is still sleeping. She probably will wake up in three days."

"This guy, this time I'm probably going to improve a lot."

This is also because Lu Xue chose to set out three days later.

At this time, Ao Qing had fallen into a deep sleep on Lu Xue's arm, and a ball of flesh on his abdomen was slowly condensing, as if there was some manifestation of a change.

Lu Daosheng looked at Ao Qing for a long time before he looked back.

"Be careful in everything. If it really doesn't work, call me dad and dad will appear immediately."

Hearing this, Lu Xue nodded obediently.

"Okay dad."

......

Time flies, and three days pass in a blink of an eye.

In front of the gate of the deserted city.

Two figures slowly emerged, and they were Xiao Chen and Xiao Xuanmu of the ancient Xiao clan.

"It's finally time to set off."

Xiao Chen looked at the direction of the central domain, with a complicated expression and sighed.

On the side, Xiao Xuanmu did not respond, but just turned around and looked in the direction of the Huangcheng.

"Why haven't Miss Lu come yet?"

"No, I'm afraid of repentance."

Hearing this, Xiao Chen was silent for a moment and slowly said, "I don't think so."

Xiao Xuanmu looked at Xiao Chen, "Why?"

Xiao Chen said indifferently: "Just because she is the daughter of Lord Huang City."

As soon as these words were spoken, Xiao Xuanmu was stunned and did not refute.

And at this moment, a huge shock suddenly came from the depths of the deserted city.

Immediately afterwards, a deafening dragon roar sounded from the deserted city and then rang through the sky.

boom!

The dark clouds are covered with strange phenomena.

I saw a huge dragon shadow filled with fairy light slowly appearing over the deserted city.

The ancient aura of immortality continued to permeate the phantom.

In just a moment, the entire void was filled with this aura.

"That, that's!"

Countless practitioners from the Wood Fairy World who came to the deserted city to watch showed a look of horror when they saw this strange phenomenon.

Including two ancient Xiao clan members in front of the gate of Huangcheng City.

"It's a dragon."

Xiao Xuanmu said in a deep voice.

Xiao Chen stared at the dragon shadow's abdomen.

"Five claws? No!"

At this moment, Xiao Chen suddenly widened his eyes.

I saw a giant dragon covering the sky suddenly soaring into the sky from the depths of the deserted city, hovering above the deserted city. The entire dragon body stretched for millions of miles, and the huge dragon's eyes were like the sun and the moon, which was intimidating.

At the same time, countless golden scales gradually condensed from the dragon's body, and in a moment, they covered the whole body.

On the abdomen, six dragon claws are powerful.

Six-clawed Dragon!

No, now, it should be a fairy dragon.

At this moment, Ao Qing suddenly entered the path of immortality, broke through the blood shackles again, and was promoted to the six-clawed golden dragon.

Rumble!

At this time, dark clouds were covered with dark clouds, and the rolling thunder tribulation continued to surge from inside, looking extremely terrifying.

Ao Qing slowly raised the huge dragon head and looked at the catastrophe cloud. A hint of disdain appeared in the dragon's eyes.

"I am Ao Qing, the number one dragon in the fairy world!"

"How could I fear the little thunder tribulation!"

Buzz —

I saw Ao Qing twisting the dragon body and heading directly towards the catastrophe clouds above the void, fighting against the heavenly tribulation!

Below, when everyone saw this scene, their eyes were shocked.

Lu Xue looked slightly stunned.

"Why is Xiaoqing suddenly so brave?"

That is a catastrophe cloud, and taking the initiative to provoke the heavenly tribulation will make the heavenly tribulation even more powerful.

It seems that the strength has been improved too much, which has led to Ao Qing being completely distant now.

The next moment.

boom!

The thunder tribulation hundreds of meters thick fell straight from the catastrophe cloud and accurately struck Ao Qing's dragon head.

With a whistle, Ao Qing's scream sounded.

"Damn it, why does it hurt so much?!"

Seeing Ao Qing rolling all over in pain, Lu Xue's mouth twitched slightly.

This is too embarrassing.

Although Ao Qing is not a human being.

I have to say that Ao Qing's appearance was extremely high in this wave, and even Lu Daosheng in the City Lord's Mansion looked over with surprise.

However, this wave of screams completely broke the invincible momentum that had just been established.
